Wildlife filmmaker and Rolex Testimonee Bertie Gregory has spent his life bringing audiences closer to the natural world – from photographing animals as a teenager to filming some of the planet’s most extraordinary creatures, including the largest gathering of fin whales ever recorded. In 2025, he was awarded Rolex National Geographic Explorer of the Year with Pablo Garcia Borboroglu for their work on docuseries Secrets of the Penguins.

Recorded to mark World Environment Day, this special episode of Planet Hope is – in paid partnership with the @Rolex Perpetual Planet Initiative – available now.
